name: destiny-build
description: Evaluate Destiny 2 builds, weapon rolls and set bonuses against your own live vault, and apply them — gear, mods and subclass — via your own d2-mcp server. Also reads progression, this week's activity modifiers, the seasonal artifact, triumphs, Collections, any vendor's stock and your own clear history.

d2_mcp_url.title: d2-mcp server URL
d2_mcp_url.description: Your own deployment, e.g. https://your-app.fly.dev/mcp . Each player runs their own: Bungie rotates the refresh token on every use, so two clients sharing one grant invalidate each other.

d2_mcp_token.title: d2-mcp bearer token
d2_mcp_token.description: The D2_MCP_TOKEN shared secret guarding your endpoint. Not a Bungie credential - it only proves your client may reach your server.
